simple.meaning: רֹעִי (rôʻîy) is a Hebrew action word meaning “pastoral ; as noun, a shepherd.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 11 times in Genesis, 1 Samuel, Isaiah, Zechariah, beginning at Genesis 13:7. The surrounding contexts include kingship, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to רֹעִי (H7473) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: רֹעִי (rôʻîy) / H7473 is traced through Genesis 13:7, Genesis 13:8, Genesis 26:20, 1 Samuel 21:8 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H7473. roi רֹעִי Isa 38:12 ; Zech 11:17 , see v 1d (I), (2). above
